method: Traverse executed JANUS experiments newest->oldest to localize information/cost mistakes, then replay oldest->newest using only lessons available from successful exact reverse/provenance gates.

reverse_error_localization.what_was_right: Exact invertible permutation plus canonical CNF equality made reuse sound and witness lift possible.
reverse_error_localization.what_was_wrong_or_incomplete: Equivalence was discovered after residual materialization and refinement overhead dominated total-work savings.
reverse_error_localization.back_lesson: Keep exact inverse authority; move candidate equivalence discovery earlier and make it incremental.

reverse_error_localization.what_was_right: Reduced Q0 refinement visits by about 90.8% while preserving the exact admitted merges and trajectory.
reverse_error_localization.what_was_wrong_or_incomplete: It made recognition cheaper but did not stop the exponential-capable residual tree from being born.
reverse_error_localization.back_lesson: Cheap invariant must gate child-orbit formation, not merely post-birth canonicalization.

reverse_error_localization.what_was_right: Stronger signed-coordinate equivalence reduced states 3591->2822 and every accepted absorption had exact inverse/witness return.
reverse_error_localization.what_was_wrong_or_incomplete: The stronger canonicalization was paid per materialized residual; 2292 HAWKING_ESCAPE probes and 3,488,298 canonical edge visits exposed late discovery cost.
reverse_error_localization.back_lesson: Use Buzz as exact authority, but discover a small generator basis before repeated residual probes.

reverse_error_localization.what_was_wrong_or_incomplete: It added 2,341,138 charged visits and pruned nothing.
reverse_error_localization.back_lesson: Do not rescan the born residual to learn a route fact that should be available from parent/seed metadata.

reverse_error_localization.what_was_right: Mechanism reduced HAWKING_ESCAPE and some charged work.
reverse_error_localization.what_was_wrong_or_incomplete: Global identity was too coarse and mutated frozen trajectory: 2822->2823 states, 602->603 absorptions, 450->452 polarity flips.
reverse_error_localization.back_lesson: Negative memory must be local to the exact residual/edge context.

reverse_error_localization.what_was_right: Removed exactly 1050 duplicate failed Buzz replays while preserving the complete trajectory.
reverse_error_localization.what_was_wrong_or_incomplete: It eliminates duplicate verification after a residual exists; it does not prevent equivalent children from being generated.
reverse_error_localization.back_lesson: Retain this as local fail-cache inside a pre-birth generator verifier.

reverse_error_localization.what_was_right: 256/256 reverse maps; 244 transformed forms collapsed to one cheap signed seed-signature class.
reverse_error_localization.what_was_wrong_or_incomplete: The successful invariant remained a fixture-stage test and was not composed with actual child expansion.
reverse_error_localization.back_lesson: The seed is the correct temporal location for branch-orbit discovery.

reverse_error_localization.what_was_right: 16384/16384 exact normalization, forward, inverse, residual witness and full-formula witness; all residuals one signed orbit.
reverse_error_localization.what_was_wrong_or_incomplete: The implementation enumerated all 2^14 prefixes before using the orbit fact.
reverse_error_localization.back_lesson: The reverse certificate must be promoted temporally to the seed/parent state, before child birth.

reverse_error_localization.what_was_right: Established exact parent recovery, typed fragment reassembly, capability/identity separation, external anchor recovery, compact route naming and reversible representation namespaces without solver-trajectory drift.
reverse_error_localization.what_was_wrong_or_incomplete: These layers live in certificate/provenance space and by themselves do not reduce search-state birth.
reverse_error_localization.back_lesson: Reuse this mature provenance plane to make early branch quotienting reversible: a collapsed branch must carry a compact generator-word/name -> full anchor -> manifest -> witness-return path.

canonical_back_forth_result.meaning: On this restricted family, exact orbit structure can be certified before branch materialization, converting an explicitly enumerated exponential blocked-prefix tree into a polynomial-size proof-carrying symbolic quotient.

what_would_actually_be_needed_for_P_equa.statement: To promote this route to P=NP, one would need a proof that for every polynomial-size CNF F, the full proof-carrying branch-orbit/decomposition automaton can be constructed and verified in polynomial total work and has polynomially many reachable quotient states/transitions while preserving exact SAT decision and witness recovery.
what_would_actually_be_needed_for_P_equa.if_all_proved: A polynomial-time exact SAT algorithm would follow, which would establish SAT in P and hence P=NP.

main_risk_revealed_by_reverse_pass.risk: Useful global signed automorphisms may be sparse or trivial on general CNFs; a polynomial symmetry finder alone is not enough if the quotient still has exponentially many states.
main_risk_revealed_by_reverse_pass.consequence: The next experiment must test discovery coverage and quotient-state growth on non-factorized/adversarial formulas, not merely scale equality_family further.

next_frozen_experiment.question: How often can exact local signed/decomposition generators quotient branch actions before child birth, what discovery/verification work is paid, and does reachable quotient-state growth actually fall without using a semantic-equivalence oracle?
next_frozen_experiment.promotion_rule: No promotion from symmetry count alone; require exact trajectory/witness correctness and a frozen total-work/state-growth improvement.
